historic_survey.note: A one-story-over-garage dwelling with a face-brick and wood-panelled front and a "shadow box" soffit on chamfered bezel mouldings. The form's locational-data field gives Lot 003B, the lot next door but one; its own identifier field gives Lot 003, which is the lot the assessor puts this address on. The survey recorded every building in its area built in or before 1962 on a Primary Record, and evaluated the pre-1939 ones on Building, Structure and Object Records; a Primary Record carries no status code and no eligibility finding.
